comments.author: @cosmic-minds-origin
comments.text: The 1922 Uqair talks, run by British official Percy Cox, also created a second neutral zone, between Saudi Arabia and Iraq. That one was divided up later too, in the 1970s.

comments.author: @cosmic-minds-origin
comments.text: Worth adding that partitioning the land in 1970 did not partition the oil. The surface border was drawn and the petroleum rights stayed shared, which is why the fields are still operated jointly. The zone stopped existing on the map without stopping existing in the contracts.
